active.title: Ball State vs Ohio: Point Spread

contracts.label: Ohio wins by more than 1.5 points

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if the score differential recorded in favor of Ohio in the entire college football game between Ball State and Ohio scheduled for 2026-11-17 at 6:00 p.m. CT is above 1.5. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the score differential (Ohio's score minus Ball State's score) for the specified game. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing the event (NCAAF), ESPN, Fox Sports, and the official broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the event is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome
